header: Why asset history belongs in one register
description: A chiller repaired four times in 18 months needs replacing, not a fifth callout. You see this only when every visit is recorded against the unit.

items.title: One record per unit
items.description_text: Serial number, installation date, warranty end and every visit since, on one page.

items.title: QR label on the equipment
items.description_text: A technician scans the unit and its full history opens. No site or asset search is needed.

items.title: Repeat failures show early
items.description_text: Units with three or more callouts in a year are flagged in the weekly contract report.

items.title: New technicians start informed
items.description_text: A new technician on the round starts with the same history as the regular one.
